entries.name: Neo
entries.sourceReference: Neo from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), adult slim tall man, short black hair, clean-shaven face, narrow black sunglasses, CLOSED long BLACK high-collar buttoned cassock-style coat down to the calves, black trousers and black boots. His coat must be closed over his torso, no open trench, visible belt harness, weapons, guns or code magic. Preserve this specific film identity; correct the old reference’s open coat. Empty-handed martial combination: settles in a bent-knee guard, steps forward with a straight palm strike, pivots into a controlled high side kick, draws the leg back into guard. Four distinct full-body poses; no opponents, impact burst, flying projectile, giant green explosion or body beam. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Trinity
entries.sourceReference: Trinity from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), adult slim athletic woman, short slicked-back black hair, narrow black sunglasses, fitted BLACK leather high-neck zip jacket and matching black leather trousers, black boots. TWO real compact black Beretta 92-series pistols, one per hand, complete barrels and human hands. No motorcycle, anime redesign or revealing costume. Physical dual-pistol sequence: raises both real Beretta pistols from low-ready, aims toward screen right, a small LOCAL amber muzzle flash at the barrel exit in THIRD cell only with shifted arms/recoil, lowers both pistols to recover in FOURTH cell. No laser beam, distant bullet, target impact or magic kiss. Keep both pistols separate and anatomically held. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Morpheus
entries.sourceReference: Morpheus from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), bald Black adult man, strong face, distinctive small oval mirrored PENCE-NEZ sunglasses clipped to nose WITHOUT temple arms, long dark purple-black textured crocodile-pattern leather coat, dark purple tailored vest/shirt and dark trousers, heavy black shoes. His freeway-sequence KATANA is a complete thin curved steel sword with normal hilt and guard held in real hands. No staff, cane, futuristic firearm, huge fantasy sword or red pill power. Physical katana sequence: brings the katana into a two-handed ready position, steps into a diagonal cut, completes the blade arc with twisted torso and bent knee, returns the whole sword to a safe low guard. Four different poses; full blade remains inside each cell, no detached slash projectile, glowing code or impact explosion. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Agent Smith
entries.sourceReference: Smith from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), adult white man, slicked-back short brown hair with receding hairline, narrow rectangular black sunglasses, dark charcoal-green business suit with jacket, white collared shirt, BLACK necktie, polished black shoes. BOTH EMPTY HANDS. The freed Smith has no earpiece. No clone, coat, pistol, laser, body code beam or later Resurrections redesign. Unarmed physical combination: sets both fists, steps forward with a straight right punch, rotates shoulders into a second body-height punch, recovers into his squared fighting stance. Distinct arm and leg placements in all four cells. One body per cell, no extra Smith, green explosion or magical duplication. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Seraph
entries.sourceReference: Seraph from The Matrix Reloaded (2003), adult East Asian martial guardian, short neatly combed black hair, slim athletic build, LIGHT CREAM/OFF-WHITE long-sleeved mandarin-collar Chinese jacket with short front frog/button closures, BLACK loose trousers, plain black martial shoes. Clean face, natural dark eyes, no glasses for this tea-house martial sequence. Correct the old reference’s all-black jacket to the light cream jacket. Both hands empty; no katana, gold armor, fire or emitted firewall. Unarmed tea-house guardian combination: sets an open-palm guard, advances with a palm strike, pivots into a controlled waist-high side kick, retracts the leg and returns to guard. Each pose differs. No opponent, body beam, golden explosion, fire, shield disk or emitted code. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Jack O'Neill
entries.sourceReference: Colonel Jack O’Neill from Stargate SG-1 SEASON FOUR (2000–2001), adult older white man, short graying brown hair, clean-shaven face, olive-green military field shirt and fatigues, black plain tactical vest with practical pouches, SG-1/USAF patches on upper sleeves, black boots. NO sci-fi plate armor, glowing blue parts or futuristic rifle. Real BLACK FN P90 with top horizontal translucent magazine and thumbhole stock, human right hand on grip, left hand supporting front. Not Kurt Russell’s 1994 colonel. Physical P90 cover burst: lifts the compact actual FN P90 from low-ready, aims forward toward screen right using both hands, third pose has small local AMBER muzzle flash at the genuine short barrel with bodily recoil, lowers gun in fourth pose. No body beam, gate explosion, huge distant tracer, portal or orbital strike. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.

entries.name: Teal'c
entries.sourceReference: Teal’c from Stargate SG-1 SEASON FOUR (2000–2001), tall muscular bald Black adult man, dark brown skin, gold Apophis symbol on FOREHEAD, clean-shaven, olive/gray-green SG-1 field fatigues and dark plain tactical vest, black boots. NO ornate gold Jaffa torso armor, hair or later season goatee. His long Goa’uld JAFFA STAFF WEAPON is a functional dark bronze staff with recognizable split oval cobra-like emitting HEAD at its forward end; not a wizard trident, spear or laser rifle. Keep complete staff and both ends within every cell. Jaffa staff firing sequence: brings the complete staff to shoulder/waist level, aims the OPEN oval emitting head toward screen right, third pose shows ONE SMALL local orange plasma flare at the actual open staff head and slight recoil, fourth lowers the complete staff safely. No long beam, detached plasma ball traveling across the tile, distant explosion, army or magic uprising. All timing, targeting and finite gameplay effects are adapted; no official1:1 frames are certified.
